Projects

Featured · Live on Render · 2026

Mind Metrics

Mental health score prediction with machine learning.

An end-to-end ML pipeline that takes a user's daily habits and predicts a mental health score out of 10. I did the data preprocessing, EDA, feature engineering and model evaluation, then built a FastAPI backend that serves the model through REST APIs for real-time predictions.
